discarded.decision: Game Director, 27 Nov 2026: Martin Krpan is pixel art only; the high-fidelity 48×48 gameplay sprite pack (Codex, PR #35) is discarded completely. It left the game in 0.21.0 (25 Nov: heroes and enemies use simple pixel sprites) and its files left the repository on 27 Nov: the pose atlases, the frame exports, the sheet and strip, the previews and the asset review.
discarded.recover: Git history: commit 99c2d99 (main, 0.20.0) still holds every file under art/source/characters/martin-krpan/atlases, art/exports/characters/martin-krpan, art/previews/characters/martin-krpan and docs/art-benchmarks/martin-krpan/ASSET-REVIEW.md, and this manifest's sprite sections.

inGame: Krpan is drawn with the hand-made pixel sprite of src/art-extra.js / src/game.js (SPRITES.krpan) in every Kakovost slik. His painted skill cards (art/source/characters/martin-krpan/folk-art/skills, art/manifests/folk-skill-cards.json) are a separate pack and stay.
